contents.description: Évaluation diagnostique en anglais 3ème : temps passés, vocabulaire avancé, compréhension de textes complexes, expression écrite

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence in the past simple:
choices: Yesterday, I go to the museum and see amazing paintings.
Yesterday, I went to the museum and saw amazing paintings.
Yesterday, I have gone to the museum and saw amazing paintings.
Yesterday, I was go to the museum and seen amazing paintings.

questions.question: Complete: I have lived in Lyon ___ 2019.
In reported speech, 'He said: I am tired' can become 'He said he was tired'.
Complete the first conditional: If it rains, we ___ at home.
Write a polite opening sentence for an email to your English teacher.
Choose the correct passive form: The homework ___ by Sarah yesterday.
The modal verb 'must' can express a strong obligation.
Explain the difference between 'for' and 'since' in one short sentence each.
